messages:
Ali: Hey team — inbound from GreenGrove Health. They sent a ~40-question vendor compliance pack (mix of vendor Qs + CAIQ snippets). Need an owner for answers and an ETA. They also asked for SOC2 evidence, KMS/BYOK details, EU data residency confirmation, and a staging contact for the POC. Link: https://files.gdrive/greengrove-pack.pdf

Jordan: I can take the infra/POC questions. @Maria can you handle the security control answers and SOC2 bits?

Maria: Happy to. Quick clarifying Qs: do we have a recent SOC2 snapshot to share? Also, is GreenGrove targeting Hosted or Dedicated for the POC? BYOK support differs.

Sam: FYI legal will want DPIA notes if data is PHI. I'll queue the redline request with legal.

sec-bot: New intake created — ticket VG-2026-118. Status: open, owner: unassigned.

Ali: They explicitly said BYOK for keys and asked: "Do you persist prompts/inputs, and if so where/how long?" Also they want a single named contact for the questionnaire Q&A.

Maria: Short answers we can give right away: - Default logs retention: 30 days (configurable). - Hosted: no customer-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private: BYOK supported via KMS/HSM integrations. Need infra confirmation for partner-managed KMS options.

Jordan: For the POC environment we can provision a small Dedicated trial (1x A10G) — provisioning ETA ~2 business days once approved. We support OIDC and SAML for SSO. Example config snippet for the staging SSO:

```yaml
ssoconfig:
  protocol: oidc
  provider: okta
  redirect_uri: https://staging.greengrove.example.com/callback
```

Ali: Great — can we commit to getting questionnaire responses back within 5 business days? Customer expects a fast turnaround.

Maria: I can draft the security control answers + collate SOC2 artifacts in ~4 business days. KMS/BYOK confirmation depends on Eng-Infra; might add 1-2 days. @Jordan please loop infra.

Jordan: Pinging infra Slack channel now. @sec-bot, update ticket owner to Jordan and Maria so legal/ops see the assignment.

sec-bot: Ticket VG-2026-118 owner updated: Jordan, Maria. Status: in progress.

Sam: Adding this to the deal checklist and setting a calendar reminder for a 4-day follow-up. Pricing note: Dedicated trial is waived for POC (confirming with sales ops).

Ali: I'll email GreenGrove to set expectations: named contact (Ali), we aim for draft answers in 4-5 business days, and we'll confirm BYOK/path as soon as infra responds.

Maria: One potential blocker: if they insist on a full CAIQ mapping for the Hosted option, that typically takes 10+ business days to complete. Flagging now so sales has the risk on the timeline.

Jordan: Noted. I'll ask the customer to confirm Hosted vs Dedicated preference. If they accept Dedicated trial, timeline shortens considerably.

Ali: I'll get preference by EOD and update this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:"
